function: Excluded (above_phy): actor-critic DRL picks radio map distribution mode, computation allocation and bandwidth allocation in UAV-assisted MEC (p. 6); a CNN builds radio maps (p. 5).
notes: The learning acts above the physical layer. The DRL agent chooses the radio map distribution mode (a computation offloading choice among DEC, DLC, DCC, ICC), the computation allocation and the bandwidth allocation: action space (m, F, W) on p. 6, 'joint computation offloading and resource allocation' on p. 2, delay-plus-energy cost on p. 4. UAV transmit power is fixed at 500 mW (p. 7) and no beams, precoder or other physical-layer signal processing is learned; the link is a free-space LoS rate model (p. 3). Bandwidth allocation here is one input of an MEC offloading problem, so the aerial-link clause of Step 1.4 is not read as making it a physical-layer decision. The CNN super-resolution (p. 5) builds radio maps, a spectrum-map function outside the seven areas. Quantitative simulation results are reported (pp. 8-9), so results does not apply.
